title: Plaintiff's Brief in Support of Motion to [RELIEF]

body.text: [One sentence framing the dispute.] [Two to three sentences of the concrete problem.]
The relief requested is narrow and enforceable. Plaintiff asks the Court to [specific relief].
I. [Full-sentence proposition the Court could adopt, with the statutory or case hook.]

[Rule with citation, case name italicized with the builder's markup: *State v. Salinas*, 2016 WI 44, ¶ 30, 369 Wis. 2d 9, 879 N.W.2d 609.] [Sub-rule or factor list. *Id.* ¶ 43.] [Application to these facts, naming the record. (Doc. __:__)] [Best counter-argument and the answer to it. *See also* Wis. Stat. § ___.]

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court enter an order [precise relief, matching the motion word for word], and granting such other and further relief as the Court deems just and proper.
